lines.text_source: [14][C4]@"What are you doing[01]here, Captain Rasso?"
lines.speaker: npc

lines.text_source: [0C][04][14][C4]@"I have been told[01]that there are[01]people[02]somewhere here in[01]these ruins...[02]Have you seen them?"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [0C][04][14][C4]@"Disseram-me que ha pessoas[02]por aqui nas ruinas...[02]Voce as viu?"
lines.risk_notes: Tenho/He been told - estrutura verbal complexa em pt-BR; mantida com naturalidade causal

lines.text_source: [14][81][01]"I just asked them[01]where I might find[01]the dragon."
lines.speaker: npc

lines.text_source: [0C][03][14][02][02]"You would use force[01]against innocent[01]women and children!?"
lines.speaker: Nina
lines.risk_notes: Nina - voz firme, lideranca; nunca passiva. Indignacao moral clara; manter intensidade

lines.text_source: [14][80]@"What is it to you[01]if I do?[02]They don't matter...[01]Their lives mean[01]nothing."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][80]@"Por que lhe importa?[02]Eles nao importam...[01]Suas vidas nao significam nada."
lines.risk_notes: Vilao cruel; preservar cinismo e desprezo pela vida humana; nao suavizar

lines.speaker: Ryu
lines.risk_notes: Ryu - voz simples, direta, honesta. Poucas palavras; nunca verbose. Contraste com Fou-Lu critico

lines.text_source: [0C][06][14][C1]@"Every life is[01]important![02]Every life has[01]meaning.[02]How can you say such[01]a thing!?"
lines.speaker: Nina
lines.base_translation: [0C][06][14][C1]@"Toda vida importa![02]Toda vida tem significado.[02]Como voce pode dizer isso!?"
lines.risk_notes: Nina - lideranca compaixao firme; cada vida importa - tom apaixonado mas nao ingenu

lines.text_source: [14][01][01]"Ha ha ha![0B] How[01]touching, Princess.[02]How compassionate,[01]how caring...How[01]dross.[02]Who are you to talk[01]to me in such a way?[02]Just because you got[01]lucky once,[02]don't think you can[01]talk down to me like[01]that."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][01][01]"Ha ha ha![0B] Que tocante, Princesa.[02]Que compassiva, que solidaria...Que lixo.[02]Quem voce pensa que e para me falar assim?[02]Porque sorte uma vez,[02]nao pense que pode me rebaixar desse jeito."
lines.risk_notes: Vilao - desprezo absoluto pela compaixao; sarcasmo corrosivo; 'dross' (lixo) = traducao forte. Alto risco por tom de menosprezo extremo

lines.text_source: [0C][05][14][02][02]"What are you[01]doing!?[02]Our orders are to[01]find the dragon and[02]return with him to[01]the Empire!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [0C][05][14][02][02]"O que faz!?[02]Nossas ordens sao encontrar[01]o Dragao e volta-lo ao[02]Imperio!"
lines.risk_notes: NPC - urgencia, ordens imperiais; manter formalidade militar; 'dragon' = Dragao (glossario)

lines.text_source: [14][80]@"You don't have to[01]remind me what our[01]orders are![02]They don't say he has[01]to be in one piece,[01]though.[02]I figure we can make[01]him a little more...[02]cooperative, if you[01]know what I mean!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][80]@"Nao precisa me lembrar![02]Mas as ordens nao dizem que tem de vir inteiro,[02]ne?[02]Acho que posso deixa-lo um pouquinho[02]mais...cooperativo, se voce me entende!"
lines.risk_notes: Vilao - ameaca de tortura contra o dragao; tom sadico; 'cooperative' eufemismo para dor. Preservar frieza cruel

lines.text_source: [14][85]E"Aaaahhhhhh..."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.risk_notes: Onomatopeia de grito; localizada em pt-BR (Aaahhh = convencao)

lines.text_source: [14][85]E"Uuuurrrrrraaaahhh!!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.risk_notes: Onomatopeia de grito agoniado; localizada

lines.text_source: Watching what happened, I[01]knew that something was not[01]right in the world.
lines.speaker: system
lines.base_translation: Vendo o que aconteceu, soube que algo[01]nao estava certo no mundo.

lines.text_source: That something...was out of[01]balance.

lines.text_source: And, for the first time,

lines.text_source: I felt afraid.
lines.speaker: system

lines.text_source: [14]D@"What are you[01]planning on doing[01]with that dragon?[02][14][C4]@Are you going to[01]use him to go to[01]war on the Empire!?"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14]D@"O que pensa fazer[01]com esse dragao?[02][14][C4]@Vai usa-lo para[01]guerra contra o Imperio!?"
lines.risk_notes: NPC questiona intencoes com dragao e Imperio; risco por confusao de ID entre falantes (verif. parenteses de fala)

lines.text_source: [14][07]F"Is that so!?[02]I've heard that the[01]only reason there[02]is no permanent[01]truce between us[02]is because Ludia[01]keeps arguing over[01]the details!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][07]F"E verdade!?[02]Ouvi dizer que a unica razao[01]para nao haver tregu permanente[02]e porque Ludia fica discutindo[01]os detalhes!"
lines.risk_notes: Diplomata/autoridade - 'truce' e 'permanent' implicam paz fragil; 'Ludia' = NPC nomeado (glossario)

lines.text_source: [14][08][07]"So? Nothing wrong[01]with that![02]What about what your[01]friend Rasso did,[01]huh!?"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][08][07]"Entao? Nada de errado nisso![02]E o que seu amigo Rasso fez,[01]hein!?"
lines.risk_notes: NPC defende-se voltando critica; 'Rasso' = vilao anterior; manter tom afiado

lines.text_source: [14][09][03]"I wonder...Is it[01]because he's not[01]whole?[02]I mean, maybe[01]because of that,[01]he's...[02]I don't know,[01]unstable or[01]something."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][09][03]"Fico me perguntando...Sera porque[01]nao esta inteiro?[02]Quer dizer, talvez por isso[01]ele fique...instavel ou[02]algo assim."
lines.risk_notes: Especulacao sobre dragao 'incomplete' ou 'unstable' - alto risco por foreshadowing de identidade (Fou-Lu/Ryu split). Manter ambiguidade
